name: Chalk user-facing job and webhook failures
description: Tenant-attributed job failures, stranded Recording stops and terminal SDK join/media reports. One affected participant in ten minutes alerts on the next evaluation. Normal retries and transient media changes do not count; test Tenants remain visible. An Episode the deadline scheduler keeps failing for alerts after more than five consecutive failed passes (sixty for a busy publication fence). Sync readiness, the database being unreachable and the runtime health (API and tunnel) each alert on three unhealthy minute samples in four minutes while the latest sample remains unhealthy, and repeat every 30 minutes until they recover. Chalk SFU readiness (any node of the fleet) and an unpaid Chalk SFU retirement debt older than its limit each alert on four unhealthy minute samples in five minutes while the latest sample remains unhealthy. Failed TURN credential mints and refused Chalk SFU Episode recoveries alert from API logs when they repeat within five minutes. A certificate within 21 days of expiry (the Chalk SFU server certificate, the API's SFU client certificate or the direct door's certificate) alerts once at 21 days and again at 7 days; a direct door that cannot finish a TLS handshake alerts at once. A new class that leaves the Chalk SFU for Cloudflare (or is refused) alerts on the first overflow event.
aplQuery:
['${LOG_DATASET}'] | where chalk_alert_stream == 'production-state-v2'${WINDOWED_RULES_EXCLUDED} | summarize arg_max(_time, chalk_alert_value, chalk_alert_headline, chalk_alert_summary, chalk_alert_next, chalk_alert_engineers) by chalk_alert_rule, chalk_alert_tenant | where _time > ago(5m) | extend alert_message=strcat('
', chalk_alert_tenant, '
', chalk_alert_rule, '
', chalk_alert_headline, '
', chalk_alert_summary, '
', chalk_alert_next, '
', chalk_alert_engineers, '
') | summarize value=max(chalk_alert_value) by alert_message${RULE_BRANCHES}${CONNECTION_REPORT_BRANCH}

name: Chalk API requests or Sync connections are failing
description: Joining, loading, Recording or class connections may be failing right now. Normal leaves and server drains do not count.
aplQuery:
['${LOG_DATASET}'] | union ['${TRACE_DATASET}'] | where (['service.name'] == 'chalk-api' and ['attributes.event'] == 'http.request' and ['attributes.status'] >= 500) or (['service.name'] == 'chalk-sync' and (name == 'sync.http.upgrade_rejected' or (name == 'sync.websocket.closed' and ['attributes.custom']['close_kind'] == 'abnormal'))) | extend rule=iff(['service.name'] == 'chalk-sync', 'sync', 'api') | extend weight=iff(rule == 'sync', 3, 2), headline=iff(rule == 'sync', 'People are being disconnected from classes or cannot connect right now', 'Chalk is returning errors to people in class'), summary=iff(rule == 'sync', 'More than ten failed connections or abnormal drops occurred in five minutes. Normal leaves and server drains are excluded. Tenant attribution is not available for these events.', 'More than fifteen server errors occurred in five minutes. Joining, loading or starting a Recording may be failing right now. Tenant attribution is not available for these events.'), next='An engineer must investigate now; customers may need to reconnect after the cause is fixed.', engineers=strcat('For engineers: ', rule, '; open the affected Axiom dataset and run | search <episode-id> using the affected Episode ID.') | extend alert_message=strcat('

', rule, '
', headline, '
', summary, '
', next, '
', engineers, '
') | summarize value=sum(weight) by alert_message

name: Chalk production alert state is stale
description: A named alert rule has written no row for three minutes, so that rule cannot alert until this is fixed. A host that is lost or cut off writes no row at all, so this is also how a lost Sync host shows. Each missing rule alerts on its own.
aplQuery:
print rule=dynamic(['recording', 'recording-stop', 'export', 'transcript', 'webhook', 'sync-readiness', 'database-unreachable', 'runtime-health']) | mv-expand rule to typeof(string) | join kind=leftouter (['${LOG_DATASET}'] | where chalk_alert_stream == 'production-state-v2' and _time > ago(3m) | summarize seen=count() by rule=chalk_alert_rule) on rule | extend value=iff(isnull(seen) or seen == 0, 1, 0), alert_message=strcat('

', rule, '
Chalk production alert state is stale for ', rule, '
No ', rule, ' row arrived in three minutes, so this rule cannot alert. Other rules may be fine.
An engineer must check systemctl status chalk-alert-state.timer chalk-alert-state.service on the host now.
') | project alert_message, value
